items.title: Labcorp Holdings (LH) Unveiled The First FDA Cleared Single Biomarker Alzheimer’s Blood Test
items.summary: Labcorp Holdings (NYSE: LH) introduced the Elecsys pTau-217 blood test, the first FDA-cleared single biomarker test for Alzheimer’s disease, expanding access through primary and specialty care. The Elecsys pTau-217 test is positioned to support clinical assessment of cognitive decline with a minimally invasive blood draw instead of more invasive procedures.
